Its M1 is thin (only a membership page; live run progress moves to M2), and M2 is lopsided at 16 pipelines. Some split packets mark files as '(new)' that an earlier spine already created. On balance A's design depth and Stage 1 fidelity outweigh B's fuller Stage 4.
